comments: The release date refers to CLI 0.3.1, published November 11, 2026 UTC. The CLI is free and open source; the hosted service has limited free functionality and a paid subscription. Manual-review notes record human checks; automated results are not a conformance certification.
features: GatekeeperQA combines automated web accessibility checks with saved manual-review notes and retest evidence. It provides a hosted public-page scanner, a local CLI and GitHub Action, with report exports and sharing. Automated results require human review and do not establish conformance.
title: GatekeeperQA
